title: Clinical & Salon Real-Life Photographic Reference Dataset
description: Authentic, licensed clinical dermatology, trichology, and professional salon photographic reference library for validating anatomically and photographically realistic hair visualization.
validation_criteria: Hairline: Anatomically natural micro-irregularity with single-hair follicular emergence
Scalp & Parting: Dermal separation with authentic skin tone and contact occlusion (no dye bleeding)
Density: Follicular unit packing matching 130-300 FU/cm² with physically correct scalp exposure
Texture: 4 distinct archetypes (1A-4C) with Kajiya-Kay / Marschner anisotropic specular response
Canities: Dimensional grey and white fibers retaining cuticular lipid sheen (no chalky white helmet)
Color: Physically plausible melanin lift across Levels 1-10 with intact fiber depth and undertone
Eyebrows: Harmonious melanin coupling with hair level (no jet-black brows on platinum/white hair)
Face & Skin: Identity preservation across 10 calibrated Fitzpatrick/Monk phototypes without plastic smoothing
